_comment: Undyed satin (Phase08 8.4, RD-P08-5): a five-end warp satin in fine polyester filament, the face of a lining, a slip dress or a blouse. Authored white so a Creator's tint (a 0-1 multiply) reaches every dyed colour. OPAQUE, glossy, with SPECULAR ANISOTROPY: the face is almost all warp float, so the highlight is stretched across the warp (the warp runs along V; the highlight along U, as the hair's, Learnings B9). No fuzz: filament does not shed. The weave is the article's own normal and roughness.
name: Satin_Natural_Clean_Base_s001_v01

sources.why: Colour: undyed (optically unbrightened) polyester filament, a slightly warm white (linear 0.80, 0.79, 0.76; no measured value). IOR 1.57: polyester (PET, ~1.57 across the fibre). Roughness ~0.24 in the map: a lustrous float face, rougher at the interlacings. Anisotropy 0.7: long parallel floats (no measured value; Hair's 0.8 is a single fibre).
